//: All fields are optional. Omitted fields are auto-derived from GPU hardware properties (CU count, VRAM, warp size). Set fields here to override the auto-detected values.
//min_n: queries with less anchors will be handled on cpu
//long_seg_buffer_size: maximum number of anchors to fit in the aggregated long segment buffer.
//max_total_n, max_read: maximum number of anchors / reads to fit in one micro batch. Make sure this fits in the device memory.

range_kernel.//cut_check_anchors: Number of anchors to check to attemp a cut
range_kernel.//anchor_per_block: Number of anchors each block handle. Must be int * blockdim

score_kernel.//micro_batch: Number of micro batches per GPU worker call. Default 1 (batch accumulation targets one micro-batch). Increase only if dispatched batches exceed max_anchors_per_worker.
score_kernel.//long_griddim: To achieve the best occupancy for the long kernel, long_griddim is usually optimal at 2* No. of CUs
